Definition: from a compound of G4012 and ψάω (to rub); something brushed all around, i.e. off-scrapings (figuratively, scum):--offscouring.
BiblicalUsage: Peripsoma is the offscouring, the scrapings brushed off all around. Paul says the apostles are made as the filth of the world, the offscouring of all things unto this day.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the offscouring is the apostle's crown in disguise: scraped off by the world, and kept by God.
